subject: Targeted RPO scope amendment for limited-geo failover
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@trustbank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 16:14:00 -0500
Subject: Request: Narrowed RPO carve for APAC warm‑standby

Ben —

Thanks again for the call today. As we discussed, our legal and ops teams want to propose a limited carve to the standard multi‑region failover obligations in the SOW: specifically, TrustBank needs to cap the RPO obligation for APAC warm‑standby activations to 6 hours (instead of the global 1 hour) for an initial 12‑month period while we validate cross‑region replication under our regulatory constraints.

This is driven by our on‑prem data persist timelines and the need to stage a phased replication rollout. We still expect Redwood to meet the usual RTO for US/EU regions and to maintain the same monitoring and runbook standards — this is narrowly scoped to APAC data‑replication RPO only.

Attached is a short writeup of our ask (TrustBank_RPO_ask_v1.pdf). Can you confirm if Redwood can accept a temporary amendment or whether this would require an SLA exception/approval cycle? If you need, we can surface this to procurement/legal for a formal redline.

Appreciate your help —
Maria
Ops, TrustBank

---
Attachment: TrustBank_RPO_ask_v1.pdf (summary of proposed APAC RPO cap)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@trustbank.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Narrowed RPO carve for APAC warm‑standby

Maria —

Thanks for the clear writeup and for surfacing constraints. Short answer: we can evaluate a scoped, time‑boxed amendment but will need alignment across Product/Engineering and Legal. Key questions we need to confirm so we can scope the amendment: 

- Does TrustBank expect Redwood to continue retaining the full geo‑replication logs and audit trail for APAC events during the 12‑month carve? (this affects storage and retention SLAs)
- Is the 6‑hour RPO target symmetric for planned cutovers and emergency failovers?
- Are there any regulatory data‑locality exceptions we should be aware of that would prevent us from shifting replication behavior?

Naomi / Kimberly / Aditya — looped in to advise on legal language, operational impact, and technical feasibility. I can draft a proposal and a short MA (mutual action) plan if you confirm feasibility.

Next steps I propose: I will prepare a 1‑page amendment and a candidate rollback plan by EOD Monday, then schedule a short alignment call with TrustBank legal. Maria — does Tuesday 11/18 10am ET work for a quick 30m?

Best,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 11:21:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: Narrowed RPO carve for APAC warm‑standby

Team —

High level legal posture: we can support a time‑boxed carve where Redwood's operational SLA remains unchanged for monitoring, runbooks, and incident reporting. Requirements from Legal: the amendment must explicitly state the geographic scope (APAC regions list by ISO region ids), the exact metric change (RPO 6h only for APAC warm‑standby activations), and the duration (12 months) with an automatic reversion clause unless both parties agree to extend. We'll also require TrustBank to accept a limited liability cap tied to the carve, since reduced RPO increases exposure.

Operational/engineering notes (Kimberly / Aditya please expand): potential implications include: 
- Additional retention of replication checkpoints for post‑failover forensic analysis (adds storage and egress exposure)
- Conditional activation path: if Redwood detects sustained replication lag > threshold for 7d, we will notify and may require a joint remediation plan before the carve remains in effect

If acceptable, I'll draft amendment language with one liability sentence and the automatic reversion clause.

Naomi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: Narrowed RPO carve for APAC warm‑standby — proposed language and next steps

Maria —

Appreciate the patience. Per our internal alignment, attached is a short amendment draft and an MA plan covering responsibilities, rollback triggers, and an observable we can report to you weekly (replication lag 95th percentile for APAC). Key points in the draft: 

- Scope: RPO for APAC warm‑standby activations limited to a maximum of 6 hours (applies to regions: ap-southeast-1, ap-northeast-1) for a 12‑month trial period starting on the effective date of amendment. 
- Monitoring: Redwood will publish weekly replication lag reports and maintain replication checkpoint retention for 90 days for forensic purposes.
- Triggers: If replication lag exceeds 6 hours for more than two discrete incidents in a rolling 30‑day window, Redwood will pause the carve and initiate joint remediation.
- Liability: TrustBank agrees to a limited liability carve (one month of service fees) specifically tied to this amendment.

If this aligns, please confirm and I'll get Legal to issue an amendment for signature. I'd also like to confirm the Tuesday 11/18 10am ET slot for a short call; if you prefer a different time, let me know.

Best regards,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
